title: Prognostic significance of intra renal venous flow profile at discharge following hydropic decompensation for eGFR-course
summary: In interaction between heart and kidney disease, venous congestion has showed as a good tool. Now it should be observed which effects a renal congestion had on course of renal function after discharge. Furthermore, there should be observed whether it can be found some proteins in blood or urine to detect these changes.

interventions.name: Decompensated Patients with heart failure or kidney disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients capable of giving consent and cooperating, or consent provided by the caregiver
Acute edematous decompensation requiring inpatient treatment
- Acute decompensated heart failure
- Edematous decompensation due to kidney disease
Exclusion criteria:
CKD G5HD
Kidney transplantation
precapillary pulm. hypertonus
severe aortic stenosis
chronic liver disease with ascitis
pregnancy
